sentences.en: It will cure you of your headache in no time.
sentences.zh: 它会很快让你摆脱头痛。

sentences.en: When I got up this morning, I had a headache.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我起床时就感到头疼。

sentences.en: I can't help taking painkillers when I have a headache.
sentences.zh: 头疼的时候我忍不住要吃止痛药。

senses.zh: 头痛 - 令人头痛的事 形容词: headachy
